vulnerability.name: USN-8958-1
vulnerability.description: It was discovered that the .NET Blazor WebAssembly debug proxy did not properly escape certain values. An attacker could possibly use this issue to execute arbitrary code. The fix for this CVE was originally released via USN-8942-1, but it was found to be incomplete. This issue only affected dotnet10 and dotnet11. (CVE-2026-102870)  It was discovered that the Brotli decompression library used by .NET incorrectly handled certain compressed streams. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to cause a denial of service or execute arbitrary code. (CVE-2026-111497)  Alen Cheung discovered that .NET did not properly handle file ownership in certain circumstances. An attacker could possibly use this issue to elevate local privileges. (CVE-2026-114148)

statements.status_notes: Several security issues were fixed in .NET
